newsitem.title: USA: NOTICE OF SALE - Toms River, N.J..
newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Toms River, N.J..

text.p: The Board of Education of the Toms River Regional Schools
SEALED PROPOSALS will be received by The Board of

Education of the Toms River Regional Schools (the Board of Education''), a school district of the State of New Jersey situate in the County of Ocean, New Jersey (the School District''), at the Board's Meeting Room at 54 Washington Street, Toms River, New Jersey, on
until 3:00 P.M., at which time they will be publicly opened and announced for the purchase of $21,600,000 School
District Bonds, Series 1997 of the School District (the Bonds'') maturing on July 15 of the years in the
Year Amount Year Amount Year Amount

All bidders for the Bonds must be participants of The Depository Trust Company, New York, New York (DTC'') or affiliated with its participants. Purchases of the Bonds will be made in book-entry form (without certificates). The Bonds will be delivered on or about April 29, 1997. The Bonds will be dated April 15, 1997 and will bear interest at the rate or rates per annum specified by the successful bidder, payable on January 15, 1998 and

semiannually thereafter on the 15th day of July and January in each year until maturity. The Bonds maturing on and after July 15, 2008 shall be subject to redemption at par on and after July 15, 2007. The Bonds will be awarded to the bidder on whose bid the total loan may be made at the lowest net interest cost, in accordance with the terms of sale. A complete Notice of Sale containing the full terms of sale and a Preliminary Official Statement have each been prepared and may be obtained from the Board's financial advisor, Public Financial Management, Inc., 156 West State Street, Trenton, New Jersey 08608 (609/392-0462), Attention: Robbi Acampora.
